note: tails v4 (2026-10-12): three separate tails from one shared base, for tails_v4_post.py / tails_v4_field.py. As tails-v3.json, except: tails start from one shared apex inside the rump at (.03, .02, -.13) and leave it in three directions (cone angles from straight back 52, 60 and 36 degrees; around that axis 85 (up), 0 (sideways) and -100 (down) degrees), then run to tips varied from v3 in length (.837 / .775 / .750), curve and depth; radius profile as v3 from u .18 on, narrower in the shared base (u 0 .66, .08 .80, .18 .95); base: tailUnionK (.035) applies inside the sphere at c with radius r[0] and falls to 0 at r[1], so beyond the base the tails' union is the hard minimum; protectTails [p0, p1]: masked blurs are switched off where a point beyond the base is within p0 to p1 of a second tail. Design and measures: docs/design/species-construction/akinza/furbase-notes.md, Tails v4. The v3 note follows. tails v3 (2026-10-12): tails v2 with fuller tails (radius profile peaks at u .35, full through about .6, then a long taper) and blurs for the +x buttock cusp and tail 1's root rim. As tails-v1.json, plus masses (authored ellipsoids joined with a C2 smooth minimum of radius k: a sacrum under the three roots), keepY (below y keepY[0] the field is the old one, fading in by keepY[1], so the stitch stays off the crotch), islandFaces (new-surface components smaller than this are dropped), pinchPasses, foldRepair (folded faces at the stitch: passes, threshold, rings, iterations of smoothing projected onto the field).  grid: level-set grid (band = narrow-band half width); oldControls: the B-14 tail controls (carved out); tails: per tail the centreline control points (the old ones, with new separate roots) and a radius profile (root radius times a scale table over normalised length u); tailUnionK: smooth-minimum radius between tails; carve: the old tails removed from the body where T_old < margin, faded in over y (k: smooth maximum); rootK: smooth minimum between body and tails; blur: masked Gaussian smoothing stages; region: changed-field tolerance, nearSurface limit, grow (Gaussian) and gain for the fade band, cut (the stitch contour); seamRelax: iterations and rings of the stitched seam.
